staticText.source: 本頁只給未參與編題、也不是目前學習者的外部審查者使用。
staticText.text: Only independent external reviewers who did not author these items and who are not current learners may use this page.

staticText.source: 完整題庫已隨公開原始碼曝光，不能再作受控的未公開保留題；本頁只保留答案盲審的內容核對流程，而且只載入去除既定答案、目標與解說的審查資料。請勿另行瀏覽 GitHub 原始碼庫內的題庫原始碼或機器稽核結果；先自行判斷成功手，再標記「一致、需修、歧義或多解」。選「一致」時只需選落子；選「需修、歧義或多解」時必須說明理由。共核對 148 題題庫的 43 個母題組代表題及全部 48 題公開保留組，重複項合併後為 77 題；涵蓋提子、連接、救棋、直三與第二眼缺口。回條只提供單一審查者的內容核對證據，不證明難度等值、完整內容效度或學習成效。
staticText.text: The full question bank has already been exposed through the public source code, so none of it can qualify as a controlled private unseen holdout. This page supports only an answer-blind content review; its review data excludes the prescribed answers, goals and explanations. Do not consult the bank's source code or machine audit results before judging the tasks. Find a successful move yourself, then choose Consistent, Needs revision, Ambiguous, or Multiple valid solutions. Consistent requires a move; other findings need an explanation. The public bank contains 148 items. The review covers 43 parent-group representatives and all 48 publicly exposed holdout items, giving 77 distinct items after deduplication. Topics include capture, connection, saving stones, straight three and second-eye gaps. A single reviewer's receipt only supports a content check; it does not establish equivalent difficulty, comprehensive content validity or learning effects.
